note: offload-unseen-apply-ab-1113 (P2 timing): per-switch in-load A/B of the apply behind autoffunseen. --ab works: autoffenvapply, autoffbcastapply and autoffunseen are runtime switches (AutOffload.cs ShortcutOn at the hook), so each job toggles in one load, no ABBA across loads needed. Arms: both (autoffenvapply,autoffbcastapply), env alone, bcast alone, each on BP and IP, both orders = 12 jobs x ~12.5 min = ~2.5 h + smoke ~8 min. Run ONLY after offload-unseen-apply-1113.json passes (stop rules there) and on a clean night (docs/TESTING.md clean-night rules: other CPU < 10%, no clock drop, else the job is void and repeated whole; close Spotify, java/IDE). Ship rule: ON only at net >= 3 ms/s on both worlds (both-arm), correctness PASS, it/s not down > 2%. Pair as in the correctness queue (install ts3agent.package.offunseen1113 first). Run: node tools/harness/queue.ts tools/harness/queues/offload-unseen-apply-ab-1113.json.
